source: 上外版2020选择性必修第一册 Unit 3 词表(p84-87 真词;△超纲/专名跳过);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、探险/航海/极地主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The explorer led his men across the frozen sea.
words.example_cn: 这位探险者带领队员们穿过结冰的海面。

words.example_en: Few people have ever reached the South Pole on foot.
words.example_cn: 很少有人徒步到达过南极点。

words.example_en: The winter on the ice was exceptionally cold and long.
words.example_cn: 冰上的冬天异常寒冷而漫长。

words.example_en: The men spent eight months in the freezing darkness.
words.example_cn: 队员们在极冷的黑暗中度过了八个月。

words.example_en: Losing the ship in the ice was a real disaster for the crew.
words.example_cn: 船陷在冰中是船员们真正的灾难。

words.meaning_cn: (轮船、飞机等的)全体工作人员;船员
words.example_en: The crew worked day and night to save the ship.
words.example_cn: 全体船员日夜不停地抢救这艘船。

words.example_en: They had no choice but to abandon the ship.
words.example_cn: 他们别无选择,只能弃船。

words.example_en: The ship slowly began to sink under the ice.
words.example_cn: 这艘船慢慢开始在冰下沉没。

words.example_en: The men tried to survive by floating on the ice.
words.example_cn: 队员们试图靠浮在冰上活下来。

words.example_en: In that remote place there was no chance of rescue.
words.example_cn: 在那个偏远的地方根本没有获救的机会。

words.example_en: He knew there was a whaling station where he could get help.
words.example_cn: 他知道那里有个捕鲸站可以求助。

words.example_en: The men had to march continuously for many hours.
words.example_cn: 队员们不得不连续行进许多个小时。

words.example_en: Anyone left in that place would starve to death.
words.example_cn: 任何留在那里的人都会饿死。

words.example_en: Starved and frozen, they finally reached the station.
words.example_cn: 又饿又冻,他们终于到达了那个站点。

words.example_en: He set out again to sail round the continent.
words.example_cn: 他再次出发,要乘船绕这片大陆航行。

words.example_en: Antarctica is the coldest continent on the earth.
words.example_cn: 南极洲是地球上最冷的大陆。

words.example_en: The explorer was buried on a small southern island.
words.example_cn: 这位探险者被安葬在一座南方小岛上。

words.example_en: He showed exceptional leadership in the worst moments.
words.example_cn: 在最艰难的时刻他展现出卓越的领导力。

words.meaning_cn: 领导才能;领导;领导地位
words.example_en: The team survived because of his strong leadership.
words.example_cn: 正是因为他强有力的领导,团队才得以幸存。

words.example_en: The young sailor was frightened on his first voyage.
words.example_cn: 这位年轻水手在第一次航海中很害怕。

words.example_en: The great storm made a deep impression on him.
words.example_cn: 那场大风暴给他留下了很深的印象。

words.example_en: As a young sailor, he knew nothing about the sea.
words.example_cn: 作为一个年轻水手,他对大海一无所知。

words.example_en: Every time the ship dived down, he thought it would sink.
words.example_cn: 每次船俯冲下去,他都以为它会沉没。

words.example_en: The boat dived into the depths of the huge waves.
words.example_cn: 小船扎进了巨浪的深处。

words.example_en: During the storm he made a firm resolution to go home.
words.example_cn: 在风暴中他下定决心要回家。

words.example_en: He resolved that he would never set sail again.
words.example_cn: 他下决心再也不出海了。

words.meaning_cn: 极危急的;不顾一切的;拼命的
words.example_en: He never wanted to be in such a desperate situation again.
words.example_cn: 他再也不想陷入如此危急的处境。

words.example_en: Now he saw quite plainly that his father had been right.
words.example_cn: 现在他十分清楚地看到父亲一直是对的。

words.example_en: He finally understood his father's observation about life.
words.example_cn: 他终于明白了父亲对人生的那番评论。

words.example_en: His father had never been exposed to storms at sea.
words.example_cn: 他父亲从未经受过海上的风暴。

words.example_en: He had lived safely with no troubles on shore.
words.example_cn: 他一直安稳地生活,在岸上没有任何麻烦。

words.example_en: These anxious thoughts lasted while the storm went on.
words.example_cn: 这些焦虑的想法在风暴持续期间一直存在。

words.example_en: The fear lasted through the storm and indeed for some time afterwards.
words.example_cn: 这种恐惧持续了整场风暴,其实之后还持续了一段时间。

words.example_en: His friend had persuaded him to go away to sea.
words.example_cn: 他的朋友说服他出海远行。

words.example_en: His friend clapped him on the shoulder and smiled.
words.example_cn: 他的朋友拍了拍他的肩膀,笑了。

words.example_en: I guess you were frightened last night during the storm.
words.example_cn: 我猜你昨晚风暴时被吓到了。

words.example_en: His safe return was proof of his great courage.
words.example_cn: 他平安归来证明了他非凡的勇气。

words.example_en: Their tents and clothes were covered in ice and dust.
words.example_cn: 他们的帐篷和衣服上覆满了冰和尘土。

words.example_en: Only a man with an iron will could finish such a march.
words.example_cn: 只有意志如铁的人才能完成这样的行军。

words.example_en: The long climb used up the last of their energy.
words.example_cn: 漫长的攀爬耗尽了他们最后的精力。

words.example_en: Modern explorers sometimes ski across the white continent.
words.example_cn: 现代探险者有时滑雪穿越这片白色大陆。

words.example_en: The tiny boat was surrounded by huge waves.
words.example_cn: 那条小船被巨浪团团围住。

words.example_en: The crew lived in constant danger on the ice.
words.example_cn: 船员们在冰上一直处于持续的危险之中。

words.example_en: Antarctica is sometimes called the roof at the bottom of the world.
words.example_cn: 南极洲有时被称为世界底端的屋顶。

words.example_en: They camped near the border of the moving ice.
words.example_cn: 他们在移动的冰面边缘附近扎营。

words.example_en: Normally a ship would never sail into such icy waters.
words.example_cn: 通常一艘船绝不会驶入这样的结冰水域。

words.example_en: The next day the wind died down and the sea became calm.
words.example_cn: 第二天风停了,大海变得平静。

words.meaning_cn: (海)汹涌的;粗糙的;高低不平的
words.example_en: The sea had been so rough and terrible the day before.
words.example_cn: 前一天大海是那么汹涌可怕。

words.example_en: They had no tent and could not stop to rest.
words.example_cn: 他们没有帐篷,无法停下休息。
